findings.explanation: HOL4 introduces FUN_FMAP by new_specification with only FINITE P ==> FDOM (FUN_FMAP f P) = P /\ (!x. x IN P ==> FUN_FMAP f P ' x = f x). Every saved theorem that determines its value assumes FINITE, or uses {}. For infinite P the value is an arbitrary finite map. The Lean definition fixes the else branch to FEMPTY, so Lean proves ¬FINITE P → FUN_FMAP f P = FEMPTY, for example FUN_FMAP f UNIV = FEMPTY on Nat. HOL4 leaves that equation open.
findings.repair:
opaque FUN_FMAP_infinite (f : α → β) (P : Set α) : FMap α β := FEMPTY

def FUN_FMAP (f : α → β) (P : Set α) : FMap α β :=
  if h : FINITE P then
    ⟨fun a => if a ∈ P then some (f a) else none,
     by
       obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := h
       exact ⟨l, fun a ha => by
         by_cases hp : a ∈ P
         · exact hl a hp
         · simp [hp] at ha⟩⟩
  else FUN_FMAP_infinite f P
findings.lean_check:
import CandleLean.Prelude.FMap

theorem bound_list : ∀ l : List Nat, ∃ n : Nat, ∀ m : Nat, m ∈ l → m < n := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => exact ⟨0, fun m hm => by simp at hm⟩
  | cons h t ih =>
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := ih
    refine ⟨n + h + 1, fun m hm => ?_⟩
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hm with h1 | h1
    · omega
    · have := hn m h1
      omega

theorem univ_not_finite : ¬ HOL.FINITE (HOL.UNIV : HOL.Set Nat) := by
  intro h
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := bound_list l
  exact Nat.lt_irrefl n (hn n (hl n trivial))

theorem fun_fmap_infinite (f : Nat → Nat) : HOL.FUN_FMAP f (HOL.UNIV : HOL.Set Nat) = HOL.FEMPTY := by
  unfold HOL.FUN_FMAP
  exact dif_neg univ_not_finite
findings.hol4_check: ?g:(num->num)->(num->bool)->(num|->num). (!f P. FINITE P ==> (FDOM (g f P) = P) /\ (!x. x IN P ==> (g f P ' x = f x))) /\ ~(g I UNIV = FEMPTY)

findings.explanation: HOL4 defines FAPPLY f x = OUTL (fmap_REP f x). OUTL is specified only on INL, so outside the domain the value is the unspecified OUTL (INR one). The saved theorem NOT_FDOM_FAPPLY_FEMPTY says only f ' x = FEMPTY ' x there, and nothing relates FEMPTY ' x to ARB or any concrete value. The Lean none branch returns ARB, a transparent def equal to default. Lean therefore proves FAPPLY FEMPTY x = ARB by rfl, and FAPPLY (FEMPTY : FMap Nat Nat) 0 = 0. HOL4 leaves these equations open.
findings.repair:
opaque FAPPLY_outside {β : Type v} [Inhabited β] : β

def FAPPLY [Inhabited β] (f : FMap α β) (x : α) : β :=
  match f.lookup x with
  | some y => y
  | none => FAPPLY_outside

import CandleLean.Prelude.FMap

example : HOL.FAPPLY (HOL.FEMPTY : HOL.FMap Nat Nat) 0 = (HOL.ARB : Nat) := rfl
example : HOL.FAPPLY (HOL.FEMPTY : HOL.FMap Nat Nat) 0 = 0 := rfl
